messages:
Ava (AE): quick handoff — new trial customer (HelioPay) signed for private eval + SSO + dedicated-ish capacity. Sales notes below, please call out owners and blockers. key risk: finance needs po by week 3.

Ava (AE): summary: private eval in our us-west VPC, SSO (okta), sample traffic ~200 req/min, wants perf numbers + cost estimate for dedicated pool. they also asked about data residency.

Ravi (CSM): got it. i'll own onboarding + SSO. can you drop jumpstart creds and the sample dataset? also who is owning the dedicated capacity estimate?

Ava (AE): assigning ded estimate to Eng for sizing. ticket created: INF-4821. sample dataset link: https://redwood-internal/files/helio-sample.csv

Leah (Eng): i'll take INF-4821. quick Q: what's the expected seq len distribution? 95th pct ~?

Ava (AE): most requests are short (<=128) but some long summaries up to 2048 tokens ~5% of traffic. default model request is rdx-medium.

Leah (Eng): OK. i'll run a quick perf + cost sim. ETA: EOD tomorrow for initial numbers. Need any access or customer network details?

Ravi (CSM): i will collect SSO metadata (idp cert, ACS URL) and provisioning contacts. Noah — can support prep onboarding doc and a runbook for escalation?

Noah (Support): yep. i'll draft onboarding doc and a first-72h playbook. will also add a contact matrix and preferred SLAs. pinged for template: /templates/onboard-private.md

Leah (Eng): one potential blocker: private eval requires a VPC peering request and k8s nodepool with GPUs if they want latency under 100ms. who owns cloud request?

Ava (AE): ops will do peering; i've informed their infra lead. ops-bot — can you create a peering ticket?

ops-bot: Created ticket NET-7734 for VPC peering. assigned to eng-infra oncall. ETA 2 business days.

Ravi (CSM): owners roundup: SSO & onboarding (Ravi), dedicated sizing (Leah), onboarding doc + support playbook (Noah), peering (eng-infra via NET-7734), contract/finance (Ava). i'll make a single owner doc and share in the onboarding folder.

Leah (Eng): noted. i'll add perf sims and a recommended quant/instance config to INF-4821. if we need canary rollout, recommend small canary capacity + automatic fallback to hosted variant.

Ava (AE): renewal-risk note: customer is cost-sensitive and asked about unit economics. Ravi, can you capture pricing expectations in the kickoff?

Ravi (CSM): will do. adding a pre-kickoff checklist: 1) collect IdP metadata 2) confirm sample traffic 3) confirm data residency 4) finance PO timeline 5) perf expectations 6) success metrics.

Noah (Support): i'll cross-link the onboarding doc with runbook and include escalation paths to eng oncall + account manager.

Ravi (CSM): thanks team. i'll schedule kick-off for Tue 10am PT and post agenda + notes here. please add any blockers to INF-4821 or NET-7734. :thumbsup:
